Title: Student and Staff Computing Devices
Bid Submission Type: Online via the iSupplier portal or manual submissions delivered to the Procurement Services Department in a sealed envelope; no fax or email submissions will be accepted.
Term of Bid: The term of this proposal shall be for a three (3) year agreement with two (2) successive one (1) year extensions based on the long-range needs of the District and mutual consent of both parties.
Pre Bid Meeting: A pre-proposal meeting will be held at 2:00 PM CST via TEAMS video conference on June 10, 2024.
Installation: All deliveries and deployments must incorporate white glove services, which include asset decaling, asset reporting, etching, and delivery to varied locations.
Any Additional Documentation Required: W9 Form; Form 1295 - Certificate of Interested Parties; M/WBE Compliance Guidelines and Forms; signed addenda
Product: laptops; desktops; tablet devices; display monitors
Bid Summary: This Request for Proposal (RFP) will be for student and staff computing devices, including laptops, desktops, tablet devices, and display monitors. Vendors may submit proposals for one, several, or all categories of devices required by the District.
Product Specification:
Tier 1 Small Student Chromebook Laptop Minimum Requirements: Enterprise Management Ready; Intel Celeron Processor N100 or equivalent; Display: Minimum 11.6" diagonal; Integrated Camera: 720p minimum; Screen Resolution 1366 x 768 Multi-touch; Memory: Minimum 8GB DDR5 Memory; Wireless: 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1; Power Supply: Type C, 65W; Battery Life: Minimum 10 hours; Ports: Minimum 2 USB 3.0; type C; 1 headphone/microphone combo; Storage: 64 GB eMMC; Chrome O/S License Required; Warranty: 1-year minimum.
Tier 2 Large Student Chromebook Laptop Minimum Requirements: Enterprise Management Ready; Intel Celeron Processor N100 or equivalent; Display: Minimum 14" diagonal Non-Touch; Integrated Camera: 720p minimum; Screen Resolution 1920-1080; Memory: Minimum 8GB DDR5 Memory; Wireless: 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1; Power Supply: Type C, 65W; Battery Life: Minimum 10 Hours; Ports, Minimum 2 USB 3.0; 1 Type C; 65HDMI; 1 headphone/microphone combo; Storage: 128 GB eMMC; Chrome O/S License Required; Warranty: 1-year minimum.
Tier 3 Student Windows Laptop Minimum Requirements: Enterprise Management Ready w/ Autopilot Enrollment; Intel i5 13th Gen or equivalent; Display: Minimum 13" diagonal; Integrated Camera: 720p minimum; Screen Resolution 1920-1080 Non-Touch; Memory: Minimum 16GB RAM DDR5 Memory; Wireless: 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1; Power Supply: Type C, 65W; Battery Life: Minimum 10 Hours; Ports, Minimum 2 USB 3.0; 1 Type C; 65HDMI; 1 headphone/microphone combo; Storage: 256 GB NVMe SSD; Windows 11 Pro; Warranty: 3-year minimum.
Student Tablet Minimum Requirements: Enterprise Management Ready; Processor A13; Display: 10.2" Retina; Integrated Camera: 8MP Wide camera; Screen Resolutions 2160 x 1620 Multi-touch; Wireless: 802.11AC and Bluetooth 4.2; Power Supply included; Battery Life: Minimum 10 Hours; Ports: 1 headphone or other personal audio connection; Storage: 64 GB; iOS 17; Warranty: 1-year minimum.
Tier 1 Staff Windows Basic Desktop Minimum Requirements: Enterprise Management Ready with Autopilot Enrollment; Processor: Intel i5 Processor, 14th Gen or equivalent; Display: Minimum 23.8" diagonal screen Touch Screen; Memory: Minimum 16GB RAM; Wireless: 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1; Ports: Minimum 3 USB 3.0; 2 USB-C1 HDMI; 1 headphone/microphone combo; Storage: 512 GB NVMe SSD; Windows 11 Pro; Warranty: 3-year minimum.
Tier 2 Staff Professional Desktop Minimum Requirements: Enterprise Management Ready; Intel i7 Processor, 14th Gen or equivalent; Display: Minimum 23.8" diagonal screen Touch Screen; Memory: Minimum 32GB DDR5 RAM; Wireless: 802.11AX WiFi-6E and Bluetooth 5.1; Ports: Minimum 3 USB 3.0; 1 USB-C, 1 HDMI; 1 headphone/microphone combo; Storage: 1 TB NVMe SSD; Windows 11 Pro or Mac O/S; 4 GB Video card; Touchscreen optional; Warranty: 3-year minimum.
Display Monitor - Touch: Minimum 24" diagonal screen; Resolution: 1920 X 1080; Port: USB 3.1 Hub; Aspect Ratio: 16:9; Contrast: 3000:1; Warranty: 3-year minimum.
Display Monitor - Non-Touch: Minimum 24" diagonal screen; Resolution: 1920 X 1080; Port: USB 3.1 Hub; Warranty: 3-year minimum.
